title: Creative Strategy at Scale
objectives: Build a scalable Hook & Angle Library for your brand
Direct and brief micro-influencer User-Generated Content (UGC)
Identify leading indicators of creative fatigue before ROAS crashes

blocks.text: At scale, you don't run out of audience—you run out of creative! Here is how you maintain creative velocity.
When spending ₹50,000+ per day, ads burn out quickly. Top brands maintain a constant production pipeline testing 4-6 fresh hooks weekly.

blocks.title: The 4 Core Psychological Angles
items: 1. The Frustration Angle: Call out the annoying problem competitors fail to solve
2. The Transformation Angle: High-contrast Before vs After visual proof
3. The Curiosity Angle: 'The one ingredient your skincare routine is missing...'
4. The Us vs Them Angle: Side-by-side comparison debunking cheap alternatives

blocks.title: The Hollywood Movie Trailer
blocks.text: A studio doesn't release just one trailer for a blockbuster. They release an action trailer for gamers, a romance trailer for couples, and a comedy teaser for families. The movie is the same, but the hooks target different psychology!
UGC Creator Briefs: Keep creator briefs simple. Give them a 3-second hook script, product demonstration points, and let them speak in their natural language (Hinglish/Tamil/Bengali).
Leading Fatigue Signals: Watch your 3-second Thumbstop rate and Outbound CTR. If CTR drops by 25% over 3 consecutive days, fatigue has started—launch fresh hooks before CPL doubles!

quiz.q: What is the primary operational bottleneck when scaling ad spend from ₹5,000/day to ₹50,000/day?
options: Running out of hard drive space
Creative velocity: Producing and testing enough fresh hooks to stay ahead of audience fatigue
quiz.explain: At scale, audiences exhaust ads quickly. Without a repeatable creative testing pipeline, acquisition costs escalate.

quiz.q: What is a leading early indicator that a winning ad creative is beginning to suffer from fatigue?
options: Outbound CTR drops by 20-30% while Frequency climbs above 3.5 on cold traffic
quiz.explain: A declining CTR paired with rising frequency signals that viewers are becoming blind to the hook.

quiz.q: Why is user-generated content (UGC) shot in natural everyday language (like Hinglish) so powerful for Indian brands?
options: It looks and feels like authentic peer recommendations rather than polished corporate advertising
Meta charges less tax on UGC
quiz.explain: Authentic creator content blends natively into the social feed, building immediate peer trust and stopping the scroll.

quiz.q: True or False: Testing 5 different 3-second hooks with the exact same video body is an efficient way to discover new winning ads.
quiz.explain: True! The hook drives 80% of click variance. Changing just the first 3 seconds can revive a fatigued winning ad.

recap: Scale requires creative velocity: test multiple angles (Frustration, Transformation, Comparison).
Monitor Thumbstop rate and CTR daily to detect fatigue before ROAS decays.
